display_title: Call 0 to Connect to a Counselor
description:
Yu Jeong-Won, a customer service representative, is overwhelmed by calls from abusive clients when he finds comfort in a kind word from a customer. Thanks to this, Jeong-Won, who has regained his energy and finished his day, hears the voice of Lee Kyu-Hyuk, a waiter at a restaurant after work, and realizes that he is the person who comforted him earlier in the day. Unaware, Jeong-Won leaves the restaurant, clutching a sense of regret, just as Kyu-Hyuk calls out to him...

*"My part-time job is ending soon, and... um... I thought I'd regret it if we just broke up."*

Jeong-Won can't resist Kyu-Hyuk, who approaches him with a voice as affectionate as his...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*
